title: Qualify Decision and MCDM owner boundaries and complete M3 statistics work package
commitMessage: docs: qualify consumer ownership boundaries and close statistics work package

contribution.summary: Close M3-W02-C04-T2 by independently validating an 8-row Math-only Decision/MCDM/AURA ownership matrix and two richer unsent request drafts pinned to RS050's actual local NuGet evidence. Four candidate primitive evaluations, one held generic-matrix proposal and three retained business/broker scopes establish guarded transfer and rollback requirements. Qualify the C# boundary check and complete T2, C04 and M3-W02, leaving the independent G-M3 release gate open.
contribution.value: Finish the accepted statistics and probability work package with falsifiable external-owner boundaries, honest package provenance and explicit nonadoption without moving Decision/MCDM business policies or prematurely exposing Math to AURA.
debtChanges: The Math-local RS050 31-probe consumer and its actual two NuGet package SHA-256 receipts are the only observed interoperability evidence; recipient versions and tests remain unverified.
Four named candidate mathematical primitive reviews are proposed for Decision and MCDM; a matrix cutover is held without a separately pinned numerical package and recipient tests.
Decision retains VaR/CVaR, EVPI, MDP, games, graphs and solver semantics; MCDM retains PROMETHEE, FlowQuantization, preferences, criterion normalization, ties and ranks.
Both cross-repository request drafts remain explicitly unsent, pending real artifact transfer, owner agreement, signature review, business oracles and rollback verification.
An independently run .NET C# source/evidence validator checks package identity, version, prior receipt SHA-256s, candidate rows and all nonadoption statuses; it does not recompute workflow hashes.
Completing the final C04 task also completes C04 and work package M3-W02; milestone M3 remains in-progress until its separately accepted G-M3 release gate.
No sibling repository code changes, public NuGet publishing, neutral dw.discovery protocol implementation, generated agent skill, or AURA BrokerReady status are delivered.
contribution.nextAction: After RS051 durable success, qualify the independent M3 release gate G-M3 using the accepted evidence for all numerical and statistics chunks; do not infer external Decision/MCDM adoption.

achievements.achievement: Define exact Decision/MCDM/AURA owner boundaries and eight falsifiable candidate/hold/retained-external review cases, keeping recipient decisions distinct from Math package use.

Independently validate the 31-probe RS050 consumer receipt, two observed local package SHA-256s, eight owner-boundary rows, two unsent drafts and explicit recipient test/rollback requirements using C#.
Publish Math-owned rationale, guarded recipient review requests and handoff with no claimed transmission, business migration, repository change or broker-ready authorization.
Qualify C04-T2 as a bounded scientific ownership and adoption-planning decision supported by a real C# validator, not an implemented recipient capability.
Close M3-W02-C04 with qualified T1 NuGet-only consumer proof and T2 recipient-boundary decisions, while retaining Decision/MCDM policy ownership.
Complete all four accepted M3-W02 statistics and probability phases with durable native DWF/backlog evidence, leaving M3's G-M3 release gate separately pending.
